name: pos
meaning: world position, advanced by vel * g_dtMs / 1000 (Weather_Advance 0x52e8bf)

name: viewPos
meaning: last camera-space position (Weather_WrapToVolume 0x531e86); a particle that leaves the volume is mirrored through the centre from it

name: alpha
meaning: 1.0 in the air; DrawRain / DrawSnow fade it below a water surface

name: inAir
meaning: 1 = drawn with the first texture (not under water), 0 = the second one (DrawRain 0x52eb66 / 0x52ec76)
